blocks.title: Monsoon Operational Policy
blocks.text: Every year, from 1st July to 30th September, Core Zones 1 to 5 remain closed for tiger breeding season. Selected Buffer Zones (6 to 10) remain fully operational subject to weather conditions.

blocks.heading: Safari Timings FAQs
blocks.intro: Frequently asked questions about Ranthambore entry and exit hours.

items.q: Which shift is better for tiger sightings: Morning or Afternoon?
items.a: Both shifts offer equal chances because tigers are crepuscular (most active around dawn and dusk). In summer, afternoons are very rewarding around waterholes; in winter, mornings are great as tigers bask in the sun.

items.q: What time will the Gypsy pick me up from my hotel?
items.a: Hotel pickup begins 30 to 45 minutes before official gate entry time directly from your resort lobby.

items.q: What happens if we arrive late at the forest checkpost?
items.a: Gates close strictly at the designated minute by computerized timer, after which entry is barred without refund.
